feed_title: Dog Car Seat with Memory Foam Base, Raised Sides, Washable Removable Cover, 66 x 38cm Interior, Small and Medium Dogs | PawLunova Whinlatter
descriptionHtml:
About 10cm of memory foam. Raised sides. Their bed, in the car.

Whinlatter is a memory foam dog car seat with raised sides, a listed interior of about 66 × 38cm and a stated total load of about 25kg. One size.

A dog on a car seat spends the first mile working out where to put their feet. Upholstery is slippery and it slopes, so they brace, slide on the roundabout, and stand up again. By the time you reach the dual carriageway they still have not gone down properly.

Around 10cm of memory foam underneath changes the surface from sloping fabric to something that keeps its shape, and the raised sides give a shoulder somewhere to rest when the road bends.

What they get

  • Around 10cm of memory foam: A base that holds its shape under them, instead of a car seat that was never meant to.
  • A listed interior of about 66 × 38cm: With a stated total limit of about 25kg, so check your dog against both figures before ordering.
  • A seat-belt channel and an adjustable headrest strap: These position the seat. Two inside clips are supplied.
  • Fabric that comes off and washes: For the trips that finish in a beach car park.
  • It works as a bed once you arrive: So it is not one more bulky thing going into the boot.

Best for: small and medium dogs inside the listed interior and the stated load, and owners who would rather not pack a separate bed for a weekend away.

Why it is worth the money

£165 is a lot for something that lives in a footwell, and this is what the money is doing. Around 10cm of memory foam rather than a thin quilted pad. A seat-belt channel and an adjustable headrest strap instead of a strap you improvise. Fabric that unclips off the foam and washes. And it is the bed as well as the seat, which is one fewer thing to carry into a holiday cottage.

Be clear on what this is not. It is not crash-tested safety equipment. Use an appropriate vehicle restraint and follow the seat and restraint manufacturers' fitting instructions. Do not rely on the supplied clips as crash protection.

And the 25kg figure is a stated total, not a rough guideline. A 30kg dog is not this product, however much they would like to be.

Size and fit

Listed interior: about 66 × 38cm. Stated total load: about 25kg. Check your dog, your vehicle and the fitting instructions before you order.

Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15 to 20cm, then hold that against the 66 × 38cm interior rather than the outside of the seat. Not sure? Message us their breed and weight and we will tell you honestly whether it fits.

Everyday care

Unclip the fabric and wash it as the care label says. Keep the foam out of the washing machine. Let every part dry fully before you refit it.

If your dog is in pain, recovering or finding it hard to move, speak to your vet about the right resting surface. A bed is for comfort. It is not a treatment.

Before you order

Check the returns terms and confirm eligibility for this product before ordering. A bed trial or foam guarantee should not be assumed for a travel accessory, cooling mat or outdoor-style raised bed. Read the full returns and guarantee terms.

Free standard UK delivery on orders over £40. Check delivery timings and any product-specific lead time.

Check the 66 × 38cm interior against your dog and take their bed with you.
